the present extended optical model approach can successfully describe simultaneously the elastic scattering and fusion data for the $^6$Li+$^{208}Pb$ system at near-Coumb-barrier energies, and the DR part of the optical potential obtained in this work can be used for the analysis of elastic scattering data for the $d+^{208}$Pd system at near-Columb-barrier energies.
